database_limit: Commander Spellbook is incomplete, especially for new cards. No-match records are evidence, not proof of absence.
notes: All ten exact current main decks have full-list Commander Spellbook scans plus manual prerequisite review. Thorin, Henzie, and Frodo & Sam were refreshed and reviewed on 2026-09-04; Gandalf's separate nine-card sideboard configuration remains manually preserved and reviewed.

decks.summary: The exact-list scan returned no included combo. Annie Joins Up and Roaming Throne can multiply Aragorn triggers, and Jeskai Ascendancy repeatedly untaps Bloom Tender, Faeburrow Elder, and the other mana creatures. Manual review found no repeatable spell, buyback engine, or creature recast loop to turn those engines into a deterministic cycle; all current multicolor-spell and token sequences are finite.

The exact-list scan returned no included combo. Manual review found no loop among Selvala, Devoted Druid, Pip-Boy 3000, Bear Umbra, or the Equipment-copy package; the deck's sharp finishes remain finite commander-damage attacks.

The refreshed exact-list scan returned no included combo. Hobbit Hole replaces Terramorphic Expanse without adding a repeatable Food, life-gain, sacrifice, or historic-card recursion loop; The One Ring and the Food/Hobbit engines remain finite.

The posted Maximum Flavor main deck returned no included combo and contains neither Surge to Victory nor Savage Beating. Its exact nine-for-nine Maximum Power switch adds both cards plus Solve the Equation, restoring the deck's intentional conditional unlimited-combat finish only in the Maximum Power configuration.

lines.reason: The line is absent from the posted Maximum Flavor main deck. In the exact Maximum Power configuration, cast Surge to Victory with Savage Beating in the graveyard; each successful combat-damage trigger can cast another untap-and-additional-combat copy.

decks.summary: Commander Spellbook returned the Mikaeus and Viscera Seer template, but the refreshed exact list still has no qualifying persist creature. Metamorphosis Fanatic and Tortured Existence improve recursion, while Kardur adds finite combat control; manual review found no replacement prerequisite or new deterministic loop.

decks.summary: The refreshed exact-list scan returned no included combo. Living Lies of Loki, Lyla, Holographic Assistant, and Monument to Endurance add Illusion, draw, counter, and discard value, but none returns a sacrificed Illusion or creates an unrestricted draw/sacrifice cycle with Minn's once-per-turn second-draw trigger.

All three returned Apex Altisaur and Wrathful Raptors lines are present. They clear opposing creatures and can deal near-infinite damage when opposing bodies keep Apex Altisaur's fight chain going; Savage Order is the compact tutored version and is the list's main Bracket 3 disclosure.

Commander Spellbook returned the finite Fire Covenant and Brash Taunter kill. Manual review also found a real but expensive five-card Arcbond loop: copy Arcbond onto Selfless Squire, make both it and Brash Taunter indestructible, then have Brash fight the Squire. The two delayed triggers feed each other while the Squire prevents damage to you.

lines.reason: Copy Arcbond so Brash Taunter and Selfless Squire each have its delayed trigger, give both indestructible, and activate Brash Taunter to fight the Squire. Each Arcbond trigger damages the other creature and creates the next trigger; Selfless Squire prevents the damage to you while opponents take every iteration.

decks.summary: The exact-list scan returned no included combo. Haste can turn the original Notary and its two token copies into nine mana, while Parallel Lives, Panharmonicon, Strionic Resonator, Maskwood Nexus, and changelings scale that output. The list has only finite untaps and token multipliers, so manual review found no deterministic loop.

The exact-list scan returned no included combo. Thorin, Bifur, Panharmonicon, Anointed Procession, Cadric, Molten Echoes, Fíli, and the other Dwarf payoffs multiply enter-the-battlefield triggers, temporary legendary copies, creature tokens, and Treasures only a finite number of times. Magda can tutor artifacts and The Reaver Cleaver can fund explosive attacks, but the list omits the repeatable untap or extra-combat pieces required by the closest Spellbook templates.
